cohort: 350 women of advanced maternal age who delivered at Shanghai Putuo Maternity & Infant Health Hospital from January to June 2016
finding: Vaginal delivery is recommended for the first delivery in women of advanced maternal age whenever possible, and management of metabolic disorders during pregnancy is crucial to reduce the caesarean section rate.
mod_finding: The majority of multiparous women in the study underwent caesarean section due to uterine scarring.
